# Dalvi Consultancy

> Pune-based software development agency and digital consultancy. We build AI solutions, custom software, websites, mobile apps, and workflow automation for businesses worldwide.

## What We Are

- Software Development Company
- AI Solutions Provider  
- Web & Mobile App Developer
- Digital Agency & Tech Consultancy
- Automation Specialists

## Core Services

- **Software Development**: Custom software, SaaS platforms, enterprise applications
- **Web & App Engineering**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Firebase full-stack solutions
- **AI Solutions**: Chatbots, ML integrations, intelligent automation
- **Mobile Apps**: iOS, Android, cross-platform development
- **Website Design**: Corporate sites, e-commerce, landing pages
- **Workflow Automation**: n8n integrations and custom scripts

## Products Built

- **RTO Buddy**: SaaS platform for vehicle registration and RTO compliance management
- **SMPG**: Social Media Post Generator tool for content creators
- **VPTC**: Virtual Public Transport Card digital ticketing system
- **Dirt Shack**: E-commerce platform for off-road gear and accessories

## Tech Stack

Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, Firebase, Tailwind CSS, n8n, PHP, WordPress, Xcode, Genkit
